Reuse existing S.I.R.E. Git, plugin, supervisor and MCP architecture without duplicating agents
Keep external calls fail-closed until a verified authenticated runner
Use Python standard library and existing Godot CI; no new costs
Separate source checks, native Godot headless execution and real device/visual proof

CLI doctor, status, routes, skills, work list/show, handoff, cmd and check operate

rollback: Close draft PR and delete only its development branch after review; main untouched.
